calls.reason: RLI reports 2.5% completion of selected freelance projects and excludes physical work, but also excludes AI-solvable writing categories. It does not establish the rate across human tasks or the size of the claimed overestimate.

The February hallucination evaluation and reasoning review document persistent factual errors, simple reasoning failures and physically infeasible plans. Evidence of internal spatial representations does not resolve these behavioral limitations.

ARC Prize reports substantial Astra progress but explicitly says its bounded benchmark does not establish AGI. Neither that evaluation nor OpenAI's disclosure settles whether known methods can fulfill the broader expectations.
